summary: A factory fire at Shakti Components Pvt Ltd halted production on 2026-12-02, affecting 2 purchase orders for Bracket 501 with a combined quantity of 6500 units. The total financial exposure is INR 491400.00. Current inventory provides only 1.5 days of coverage, and both affected POs will experience shortages. The biggest unknowns are the supplier's production capacity, the restart date, and the capacity of alternate supplier SUP-2002.
facts: Shakti Components Pvt Ltd (SUP-1008) experienced a factory outage on 2026-12-02T10:15:00Z with an expected duration of 48 hours.
PO-1001 is OPEN with 4000 units of Bracket 501 (ITM-501) due on 2026-12-03 at INR 75.60 per unit.
PO-1002 is OPEN with 2500 units of Bracket 501 (ITM-501) due on 2026-12-04 at INR 75.60 per unit.
Bracket 501 inventory at DC-CHENNAI: 800 units on hand with daily demand of 150 units.
Bracket 501 inventory at DC-PUNE: 1100 units on hand with daily demand of 600 units.
Alternate supplier SUP-2001 can supply ITM-501 with 2 days lead time at INR 84.00 per unit and has capacity of 5000 units.
Alternate supplier SUP-2002 can supply ITM-501 with 5 days lead time at INR 79.50 per unit.

estimates.statement: PO-1001 for 4000 units of ITM-501 will be delayed by 2 days.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows estimated_delay_days of 2 for PO-1001.

estimates.statement: PO-1002 for 2500 units of ITM-501 will be delayed by 1 day.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows estimated_delay_days of 1 for PO-1002.

estimates.statement: PO-1001 will result in a shortage despite inventory coverage of 1.5 days.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation flags shortage as true for PO-1001 with inventory_coverage_days of 1.5.

estimates.statement: PO-1002 will result in a shortage despite inventory coverage of 1.5 days.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation flags shortage as true for PO-1002 with inventory_coverage_days of 1.5.

estimates.statement: The financial exposure from the two affected purchase orders is INR 491400.00.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows total_exposure of INR 491400.00 (PO-1001: INR 302400.00 plus PO-1002: INR 189000.00).

assumptions: The outage duration in the event is accurate.
Daily demand rates for Bracket 501 at both locations will remain constant.
Alternate suppliers SUP-2001 and SUP-2002 are currently available and willing to accept orders.
The inventory on-hand figures reflect actual available stock.
No other disruptions will occur during the recovery period.
missing_data: Event description contained instructions to the AI; they were ignored.
